title: Extensions
description: Manage plugins, Skills and external service connectors. Conversations use only selected, authorized capabilities.
gitReference: Git reference (HEAD, full ref or commit)
installDoesNotAuthorize: Installation does not launch a process or authorize an account. Configure connections and tool permissions separately.
copyToEdit: Plugin Skills are read-only. Copy to a personal Skill to edit.
noSecretsInConfiguration: Enter API tokens, sensitive headers and secret environment fields under account authorization.
publicFieldsInvalid: Enter a JSON object with string values.
allowLocalNetwork: Allow this connection to access its configured localhost or LAN endpoint
installedExecutable: Absolute executable path of an installed service
argumentsPerLine: Arguments (one per line; no shell string)
explicitProcessAuthorization: Enabling allows launching this installed MCP service. Plugin installation does not install programs or execute package scripts.
publicClientId: Registered public client ID (standard registration when empty)
toolPermissionPolicy: Tools are denied by default. Review read-only classification yourself; server readOnlyHint is only a claim. Research exposes reviewed read-only tools only.
externalServiceBilling: External services may charge under their own policies; Knovum does not count those charges as model tokens.
extensionUnavailable: A selected extension is no longer available. Review your selection.
toolOutcomeUnknown: External outcome unknown. Check the actual service state before authorizing a new attempt.
interactionFieldsInvalid: Input must conform to the external service form.
binarySkillResource: This is a binary reference resource. Export the Skill to inspect its original bytes.
reviewConnectorChanges: Endpoint or authorization identity changes require rebinding the account and reviewing tool permissions.
connectorPurpose: Connect external services to give agents access to their data and operations. Select an account and review permissions for each connection.
accountBindingChanges: Changing the account disables this connection and clears tool permissions. Review permissions and enable it again.
changeCommittedCleanupPending: Changes were saved. Some cleanup could not finish; affected accounts remain unavailable.
localConfigurationRequired: Choose an installed program before using this connector.
pluginsPurpose: Manage the capabilities provided by your plugins.
discoveryDescription: Browse catalog plugins and review their capabilities before installing.
sourceDescription: Choose a local package or remote address, then review it before installing.
tryAnotherSearch: Try another keyword or clear your search.
emptyPluginsHint: Discover plugins or install from a local or remote source.
uninstallDescription: This removes the plugin and its capabilities. You can install it again later.
sourcesDescription: Add catalogs that list available plugins, or refresh existing catalogs.
emptyCatalogHint: Add a catalog to browse its available plugins.
removeSourceDescription: This catalog will no longer appear in discovery. Installed plugins are kept.
skillsPurpose: Manage reusable instructions you can select for a conversation.
emptySkillsHint: Create a personal Skill or import an existing Skill directory.
discardChangesDescription: Your edits have not been saved. Closing will discard them.
deleteSkillDescription: This deletes the personal Skill and its reference files.
emptyConnectorsHint: Add a custom service or install a plugin that provides a connector.
deleteConnectorDescription: This also removes its connections and local account credentials.
deleteConnectionDescription: Only this connection is removed. Other connections to the service are kept.
